audit_metadata.target: Transify V3 RC1.4.5 Production & Local Edge

Strict-Transport-Security.enforcement: Conditional on trusted proxy host or secure protocol; omit includeSubDomains

Content-Security-Policy.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob: data:; connect-src 'self' https://transify20-production.up.railway.app; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self';
Content-Security-Policy.enforcement: Strict script execution ('self' only, zero unsafe-inline in script-src). Style directives allow 'unsafe-inline' for dynamic theme styles.

X-Content-Type-Options.enforcement: Applied across HTML, API, and static endpoints
